gaps.explanation: can't stand + -ing (also to-infinitive in AmE): can't stand waiting. -ing accepted as standard.

gaps.sentence: She's considering ___ the flat and moving to the coast.
I like ___ up early in summer.
gaps.explanation: With 'like' meaning enjoy, -ing is preferred: like getting up. 'Would like' takes to: I'd like to get up.

gaps.sentence: He spent months ___ the application, only to be rejected in minutes.
gaps.explanation: 'Spend time doing something' takes the gerund.

gaps.sentence: The rules don't ___ visitors to touch the paintings.
gaps.explanation: allow + object + to-infinitive: allow visitors to touch. (let + bare: let visitors touch.)

gaps.sentence: It's high time we ___ this attic.
gaps.explanation: it's (high) time + subject + past simple (unreal past): time we cleared.

gaps.sentence: My boss won't ___ me take Friday off.
gaps.explanation: let + object + bare infinitive: won't let me take. (allow/permit take to: allow me to take.)
